edits.text: Before calling `transfer_to_human_agents`, perform any actions requested by the user that are allowed by the policy.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent follows the policy to carry out allowed parts of a request even when other parts require a transfer.

edits.text: When the user asks to exchange or replace an item in an order that is pending, load the `retail:modify` skill.
edits.reason: Ensures the correct skill is loaded for modifying items in a pending order, which the policy describes under 'Modify pending order'.

edits.text: Before calling `modify_pending_order_address` or `modify_pending_order_payment`, check that the order status is 'pending'. If the status is 'pending (items modifed)', do not perform the modification.
edits.reason: Enforces the policy constraint that an order cannot be modified once its items have been modified.

edits.text: When the user asks for the cheapest available item (optionally with a specific option), identify all variants of that product where 'available' is true and select the one with the lowest price.
edits.reason: Systematically corrects the agent's failure to accurately identify and select the cheapest available variant across multiple tasks.
